'''Docking Rectangle 16''' was a docking port in [[Cejansij]]'s [[Canyonade]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] docked his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] there when he visited in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].
